sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Another Shipping Delay is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey, brother! You say the BTR driver wants to leave Skier's gang? You know, that kind of transport would be good for my trade. But you do realize Skier won't appreciate such a move, and it's a risk to my business. Anyway, it's a lot to think about and weigh. Though, you can make the driver's offer more convincing. I got some urgent business to take care of. I lost contact with one of my crews. The guys were running a delivery and they were supposed to be back by now. Return to me if you find any sign of them."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the missing courier crew on Woods
- Survive and extract from the location

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +12,800 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.02
- 67,000 Roubles
  - 70,350 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 77,050 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Peltor ComTac V headset (OD Green)
"Someone's iced the couriers, huh? This means I have to switch routes, I've got three more trips planned! Man, I can't stop the trade, I need new routes. Maybe your driver friend could give some tips? Go ask him where I can move the goods safely. Pretty please."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to locate Ragman's missing courier on Woods. He can be found next to his burnt-out car at the gate between the big junction and the sawmill. Walk through the gate to complete the objective.
